rationale: 0.50 retains the lowest-scoring useful development evidence (D4 at 0.513) and removes all D5 live-rent and D8 inspector-count hits, plus unrelated D6. It retains both water facts for D1. D2 wrong deadlines and D3 amount-free passages remain high scoring: a threshold cannot prove support. Chosen before scored retrieval/generation; same cutoff for every question and k.

pilot_selection.reason: The longer revision did not correct the ambiguous deadline or complaint/lawsuit confusion and introduced an unsupported $1,000 dependent deduction. Select the original concise prompt, which refused D3 and all three absent/unrelated development questions. Retain both actual pilots; ambiguity and similar-process confusion remain known model limitations.

remediation.rejected_local_model: qwen3:4b: no finished non-thinking development responses under the tested 384-token cap; preserve pilot03 and interrupted04, removed unused raw-template code
remediation.token_counting: Pinned Qwen3-1.7B tokenizer replaces conservative byte bound. Eight actual development API prompt counts were each exactly text count +16 template tokens, below reserved128.
remediation.prompt: Original concise C rules remain selected
remediation.answer_limit_rationale: Original scored baseline had two length stops at384. Separate D4/D7 A development calls at768 terminated normally with271 and378 tokens; reserve768 consistently for every final A/B/C call. Window remains4096. This is a documented capacity adjustment before the repeated frozen matrix.
remediation.known_development_failures: D2 still confuses lawsuit and complaint deadlines; D7 still assumes an ambiguous case. Do not claim prompt guarantees correctness.

final_local_fallback.rationale: A non-thinking instruction model avoids the rejected Qwen3 4B runtime issue. No filter, question, gold key or C rule changed. D1 gave a complete cited answer and all three unsupported development questions refused exactly; D2/D4 emitted citation-only nonanswers and D7 refused instead of clarifying. These limitations remain; this is the last bounded model attempt.
